name: Bamoth
overview: The term Bamoth appears in Scripture as both a geographic location and a city associated with the tribe of Reuben. In Numbers 21:19-20, Bamoth is described as a camping place of the Israelites located in the country of Moab near the top of Pisgah, indicating its significance during Israel's wilderness journey. Additionally, Joshua 13:17 identifies Bamothbaal (also called Bamothbaal) as a city of Reuben, with the name meaning 'high places of Baal,' reflecting its historical context within the region. These references collectively highlight Bamoth as a notable site both in Israelite travel and tribal allotment.
